PCAP replay tile API, diagnostics, and scratch layout for publishing pcap packets as tango fragments.

# Purpose
This header file defines the interface and control metadata for the `fd_pcap_replay` tile, which reads packets from a pcap file and publishes them as a tango fragment stream. It declares the command signal `FD_PCAP_REPLAY_CNC_SIGNAL_ACK`, tile diagnostics stored in the cnc application region, and the scratch memory alignment and footprint rules used by the tile. The file also declares the public functions [`fd_pcap_replay_tile_scratch_align`](<#fd_pcap_replay_tile_scratch_align>), [`fd_pcap_replay_tile_scratch_footprint`](<#fd_pcap_replay_tile_scratch_footprint>), and [`fd_pcap_replay_tile`](<#fd_pcap_replay_tile>), which set up and run the replay process with flow control, output consumer tracking, and runtime state management. This interface is used by the codebase to configure packet replay behavior, manage tile lifecycle, and expose counters for monitoring and control.
